title: Does Pinnacle Blooms Network provide resources for parents to support therapy at home?
metaTitle: Home Support Resources for Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network empowers parents by providing at-home exercises and strategies to complement the on-going therapy sessions.
html: Indeed, we do. We believe in a holistic approach and understand the significant role that parents play in their children's progress. Our expert therapists provide you with at-home exercises and strategies that you can implement. These resources align with the on-going therapy and enable you to actively support your child's growth and development journey at home.
